categories.main_business_segments: Weathernews Inc. operates four main business domains: Sea (maritime weather services for large vessels and ports), Sky (aviation weather services for airlines and helicopters), Land (weather services for roads, railways, energy, and broadcasters), and Internet (weather information for individuals via apps and media). The company provides high-precision weather, ocean, geological, hydrological, and astronomical data-driven solutions to both corporate and individual customers globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary global weather observation and sensing network, integrating physical sensor data and crowdsourced user reports. Core technologies include AI-driven weather prediction models, high-resolution radar and satellite data analysis, and advanced big data analytics. They also utilize generative AI for user-facing weather assistants and maintain a feedback loop for continuous model improvement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include shipping companies, airlines, railway and road operators, energy utilities, broadcasters, retailers, and general consumers. Major end markets are the maritime, aviation, transportation infrastructure, energy, and media sectors, as well as individual users seeking weather information via mobile apps and online platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Weathernews operates in approximately 50 countries, with major business in Japan, Asia (notably Korea, China, Taiwan, Singapore, Thailand), Europe (including the UK, France, Netherlands, Denmark, Greece), and the Americas (primarily the US). The Sea Domain is global, Sky Domain is focused on Japan and Asia, while Land and Internet Domains are mainly Japan-centric.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned as a downstream service provider, delivering value-added weather information, risk analysis, and decision-support content directly to end users (corporates and individuals). It acts as an information and solution provider rather than a raw data supplier or hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding SaaS-based weather solutions, enhancing AI and big data analytics capabilities, and strengthening global observation infrastructure. R&D focuses on improving forecast accuracy, developing new digital products (such as generative AI assistants), and supporting climate change mitigation and disaster resilience. The company also emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and international partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through recurring (stock-type) service contracts with corporate clients (monthly fixed or usage-based fees), SaaS subscriptions, and individual user subscriptions for mobile apps, supplemented by advertising income. There is also some project-based (flow-type) revenue from system sales and consulting.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Weathernews positions itself as a global leader and innovator in private-sector weather services, emphasizing the largest proprietary database and top forecast accuracy in Japan. Major competitors include national meteorological agencies, other private weather service providers (such as Japan Weather Association, AccuWeather, The Weather Company), and emerging SaaS weather tech firms. The company claims a frontrunner position in the Japanese and global maritime weather markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending May 2025, consolidated revenue was 23.5 billion yen (approx. $150 million), with operating profit of 4.5 billion yen and net profit of 3.1 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth (5-7% annual revenue increase), high profitability (operating margin ~19%), and maintains a strong balance sheet with over 21.5 billion yen in equity and 1,120 employees. The outlook projects continued growth, targeting 25 billion yen in sales and 5 billion yen in operating profit for FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Weathernews differentiates itself through its proprietary, global-scale observation network, high forecast accuracy, and a unique 'Join & Share' co-creation model involving both corporate and individual users. The company emphasizes real-time, hyper-local, and actionable weather risk solutions, supporting customer safety, operational efficiency, and climate resilience. Its integration of AI, big data, and community-sourced sensing provides a competitive edge in both B2B and B2C markets.
